title: Unusual Tales: After Bark
description:
Unusual Tales is an episodic psychological horror game that follows a main character through what seems like a never ending nightmare. Will they make it to the end in one piece?

You are a good dog and you are part of a loving family that decide to go on a nice holiday vacation. While everything start pretty normally and without much events, it quickly turns into a nightmare to this poor family. Will you be able to warn them of what is hiding here?

This game features many things that might peak your attention such as:

• Over an hour long scary experience depending on pace

• A horror experience filled with scares

• Fun unique player mechanic

• Complete voice acting for each character

• Lighthearted writing and amusing moments

• A winter wonderland to experience and explore

• Environments to keep you on edge

• And much more!

What can a simple dog such as yourself can do to help?
Maybe they will understand your warning...
Or maybe they aren't paying attention to your cries...
description_short: You, a simple dog named Mr Peanut, find yourself in a weird cabin full of secrets... Will you be able to warn the family of the dangers? A horror game filled with mystery!
